criteria.requirement: On the delivered immutable CharsetMatch model, add stable_digest(*, mode="text", algorithm="sha256", normalization=None, text_encoding="utf-8"). Separate raw-byte and decoded-text domains, use fixed-length hashlib digests, preserve explicit encoding/newlines and default no Unicode normalization, and optionally normalize NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD. Same text in different source encodings must share text digests across hash-seeded processes while raw digests differ. Reject invalid modes/algorithms/raw normalization and preserve existing fingerprint.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
